name: Camp America
description_short: Family run day camp in Chalfont, Bucks County, for more than 50 years, serving ages 2 1/2 to 15 from preschool camp to a counselor in training program. Campers have instructional and free swim daily across several pools and rotate through sports, climbing and zip lines, arts, wood shop, drama, go karts, ponies, boating and fishing; a STEAM track (STARS) is offered for ages 7 to 12.
swim_waterfront_notes: Instructional and recreational swim every day with Red Cross certified instructors, in small groups by level; four pools, two water slides and two diving boards.
notes: Families choose 4, 5, 6, 7 or all 8 weeks; 4 week campers take the first or last four. Extended hours 7:30 to 9 AM and 4:30 to 6 PM. Door to door van transportation across Bucks and Montgomery counties and Philadelphia. Lunch and an afternoon snack provided. STARS (ages 7 to 12) needs a recommendation letter and interview. Tuition is sent on request and not posted. The homepage still shows Summer 2026 enrollment; 2027 dates not posted.
